description: CR 120.8 Benevolent Unicorn leaves Scorching Spear no damage to deal, so Ripjaw Raptor's enrage does not trigger
note: Scorching Spear would deal 1 damage to alice's Ripjaw Raptor, and Benevolent Unicorn makes it 1 minus 1. A source that would deal 0 deals no damage at all, so the Raptor's "whenever this creature is dealt damage, draw a card" has nothing to trigger on and no Plains is drawn. The control board casts Lightning Bolt instead, whose 3 the Unicorn makes 2, and that one draws.
